clue.text: Artist represented watery scene?

indicators.note: represented means the letters of the word artist are shown in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Wondering whether an artist has painted a seascape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Artist' looks like the subject of 'represented', but its six letters are rearranged into the answer; the question mark flags the loose definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrow sea channel between two landmasses is a watery stretch, playfully called a scene.

clue.text: Support coastal area

clue.text: Supply not sensitive to price changes in the Spanish wine clubs
